content.text: {"id": "mm7346a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "As of November 10, 2024, 29.7% of nursing home residents had received a 2024–2025 COVID-19 vaccine."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Approximately three in 10 (29.7%) nursing home residents received the 2024–2025 COVID-19 vaccine"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "As of November 10, 2024, 29.7% of nursing home residents had received a 2024–2025 COVID-19 vaccine."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "coverage ranging from 19.8% in HHS Region 6 to 38.6% in HHS Region 8"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "this season’s COVID-19 vaccination coverage was higher (29.7% versus 24.0% in 2023)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Nursing homes electronically report the number of residents who occupied a bed"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "this season’s COVID-19 vaccination coverage was higher (29.7% versus 24.0% in 2023)"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Estimates of coverage (percentage of residents vaccinated) with COVID-19, influenza, and RSV vaccines, and 95% CIs were estimated using Poisson regression models."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "For each vaccine, coverage was stratified by U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) region"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Nonoverlapping 95% CIs were considered to represent statistically significant differences."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "SVI categories were based on the tertile distribution of the SVI of the counties where the facilities are located."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
